[/size][size=3]A collection of my clothes creations.This way, you don't have to download individual packs.But it maybe will update slowly.[/size]

[color=#ff0000][size=3][b]This is a FS module, you need to go to Pierre to buy the hand mirror and get it through the hand mirror.If you have any questions about the FS module, please go to the fashion sense module page for reference.[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Thank you to [/b][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120958053?tab=user+files]Violetlizabet[/url][size=4][b] for creating the [/b][/size][url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/SkirtConverter]SkirtConverter tool[/url][/color][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4], which has greatly reduced my workload > < ![/color][/b]

[color=#00ffff][b]Need[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3]SMAPI, Fashion sense[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Install[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.Download and install all required.[/size]
[size=3]2.Download the pack and unzip it.[/size]
[size=3]3.Put the folder in "Mods".
[/size][size=4][b][color=#ff7700]
Because my male body frame differs significantly from the female body frame, I created two files (pack1 and pack2). Among them, pack1 is suitable for female frames, and pack2 is suitable for male frames. Unless there are extremely special circumstances, there is no difference in content between the two. Clothing with the same number is the same, but has been adjusted according to the body frame for better results.[/color][/b][b][color=#ff7700]
[/color][/b][b][color=#ff7700]
You can download as needed. If you have downloaded both files, please pay attention to distinguishing, xx_ 1 is the content in pack1, xx_ 2 is the content in pack2.[/color][/b][color=#00ffff][b]
[/b][/color][color=#00ffff][b]
Important[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3]1.This pack fits into another mod of mine. [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]click here[/url]
[size=3]2.You could choose to delete them as you like.(Open the "Stardew Valley\Mods\[FS]Kyuya's clothes pack",and delete which you dislike.)
[/size]3. You can edit this mod for your own use. But don't upload it anywhere again without my permission.
[color=#f1f1f1][size=3]4. Please do not spend money on modules published by non authors for any reason.[/size][/color]

[color=#f1f1f1][size=3]Finally, thank you for liking my module. Have a good time <3 ~[/size][/color]
[size=3]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4]感谢[/color][color=#ff7700] [/color][/b][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120958053?tab=user+files][color=#ff7700]Violetlizabet[/color][/url][size=4][b][color=#ff7700] [/color][color=#f4f4f4]制作的[/color][color=#ff7700] [/color][/b][/size][url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/SkirtConverter][color=#ff7700]SkirtConverter tool[/color][/url][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4], 这使我的工作量大大减少 > < ![/color][/b][/size][size=4]

[b][color=#00ffff]需要[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]安装[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.下载并安装好所有前置。[/size]
[size=3]2.下载文件并解压。[/size]
[size=3]3.将解压后的文件夹放入“Mods”[/size]
[size=4][b][color=#ff7700]
因为我的男性身体框架与女性身体框架差异较大，所以我制作了两个文件（pack1 and pack2）。其中pack1适用于女性框架，pack2适用于男性框架。除非有极个别的特殊情况，二者在内容上并没有不同，编号一致的服装是一样的，只是根据身体框架进行了调整以便更好的效果。[/color][/b][b][color=#ff7700]
[/color][/b][b][color=#ff7700]
可根据需要下载，如果您两个文件均下载了，请注意区分，xx_1为pack1里的内容，xx_2为pack2里的内容。[/color][/b]
[color=#00ffff][b]

重要[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3]1.这个头发包适配我的另一个模组。[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]点击这里[/url]
2.你可以根据自己喜好删除服饰。（打开  "[/size]Stardew Valley\Mods\[FS]Kyuya's clothes pack[size=3]"，然后根据清单删除。）
3.除了自己私下使用，用于其他用途的修改和上传需要我的授权。
4.不要倒卖，不要付费去购买非作者发布且无授权的文件。

最后，谢谢你喜欢我的模组，祝你玩得开心 <3~[/size]
